dedupe_keys.name: hystem extran hydrodynamic rainfall runoff and pollution load model for sewer networks

description: HYSTEM-EXTRAN is a hydrodynamic rainfall-runoff and pollution load model for large sewer networks, produced by the German engineering firm itwh. It runs single events or long-term series (module LANGZEIT) with design storms, rain gauge data or German Weather Service radar rainfall, to check hydraulic capacity and stormwater treatment in combined systems; the LANGZEIT module checks permitted surcharge frequencies under DWA-A 118 and pollution loads under DWA-A 102, HYSTEM-EXTRAN 2D couples the network with a surface model for urban flash floods, and the CONTROL package tests control strategies. Coverage is any sewer network entered in its editor; the calculation methods follow German DWA worksheets. It is commercial software with a free demo version and a free viewer for results. Caveats: licences are sold on request and the documentation is in German. Simulation uses: sewer capacity and combined sewer overflow planning, pluvial flood hazard in cities and climate adaptation of drainage. Related records: EPA SWMM (model-epa-swmm) and PCSWMM (platform-pcswmm).
